preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.intro: Language and formats apply to you only. Units are always metric.
preferences.currencySymbolHint: Optional, up to 5 characters. Overrides the symbol shown for the currency.
preferences.powerUnitHint: Power is stored in kW; this only changes which unit is shown first.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Everyone in the household shares one garage. Administrators also manage users, webhooks and instance settings.
users.resetPasswordIntro: Set a new password for {{name}}. All of their sessions will be signed out.
users.deleteBody: Delete {{name}}? Records they created stay in the garage.

instance.title: Instance
instance.intro: Settings that apply to the whole torq instance.
instance.monthlyDayHint: 1–28, so every month has the day.
instance.baseUrlSet: Configured — notifications link back to torq
instance.baseUrlUnset: Not set — notifications contain no links

about.title: About torq
about.intro: Version and the open vehicle data torq uses.
about.offline: Vehicle lookups (HSN/TSN quick-fill and make/model suggestions) always run offline against the catalog stored in torq. No API keys, no external services.
about.modified: torq modified this data (normalized names, merged sources). See NOTICE.md in the repository for details.
about.derived: The combined catalog database is distributed under the Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0.
about.empty: No vehicle catalog is loaded. Vehicles can still be entered manually.
about.updateHint: Downloads the current KBA FZ 6 list and the vehicle-makes-models data, rebuilds the catalog and replaces it in one step. This takes a few minutes; lookups keep working meanwhile.
about.updateDisabled: Online updates are turned off on this server (TORQ_CATALOG_ONLINE_UPDATES=false).

updateStates.unchanged: Sources unchanged since the last update ({{time}}).
updateStates.failed: Update failed {{time}}; the previous catalog is still in use.
